items.title: Jefferies downgrades Best Buy to Hold on slowing demand, memory cost concerns
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies downgraded Best Buy, a U.S. consumer electronics retailer to Hold from Buy, saying the market already reflects an optimistic outlook for second-quarter comparable sales while earnings upside beyond that could prove more limited amid softer consumer demand and rising cost pressures.

items.title: Best Buy (BBY) Appoints Anne Bramman As CFO For Its Next Growth Push
items.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) has appointed Anne Bramman as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President. Bramman is scheduled to assume the role on August 19, 2026. She brings experience from senior finance and analytics roles at Nordstrom, Circana, Avery Dennison, and Carnival Cruise Line. Best Buy enters this leadership change with its stock at $85.25 and a mixed performance profile. items.title: Why Best Buy (BBY) Stock Is Down Today
items.summary: Shares of electronics retailer Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) fell 2.8% in the afternoon session after BofA Securities resumed coverage on the stock with an underperform rating. The bank set a price target of $80, below the stock's recent trading price. An "underperform" rating suggests an analyst believes the stock is likely to do slightly worse than the overall market.
